summary: Named as a lookout site in Pickens County on the tnlandforms.us Georgia list; Wikipedia names a Sharp Mountain in the county. No source describes a tower or the site today.

facts.status_note: Only a tnlandforms.us list names this site. No source says whether a tower was built here or stands today.

evidence.supports: The source is a list of Georgia lookout towers
Lists a lookout site named sharp mtn in Pickens County, elevation 2353 (no unit given)
Sharp Mountain is among the notable peaks of Pickens County
evidence.quote: Other notable peaks in Pickens County include Sharp Top Mountain and Sharp Mountain.

evidence.supports: Pickens County sits in the Blue Ridge Mountains
evidence.quote: The county is located in the Blue Ridge Mountains

notes_for_editor: Confidence low: one list entry and one Wikipedia mention of a peak with the same name. The list has no units; the story gives the 717 m figure only as a conditional on the figure being feet (the brief's 717.2 m matches 2,353 ft). Nothing ties the Wikipedia Sharp Mountain to the list's coordinates. A search snippet mentioned a 2022 Pickens County Progress item about a Firetower Road near Sharp Mountain; its cached page returned no text, so it is unverified and not cited. No build, staffing or fate evidence was found. Status and access in the brief stay unknown.
